root.label: USPS announces August 21 2026 mail voting rule

events.label: USPS announces August 21 2026 mail voting rule

slots.name: announcement date
slots.sentence: On August 21, USPS announced a new rule implementing the President’s demands that require states to register every voter who is eligible to vote by mail with USPS and tasking USPS with compiling the registered voters into state-specific lists.

slots.name: rule applicability
slots.unit: application of new requirements to 2026 midterm election
slots.sentence: The new requirements will ultimately not apply to this year’s midterm election, but the high-profile legal battle magnified worries about the reliability of the Postal Service.
